response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile engineer with genuine developer-tooling credentials — he built C/C++ components for NI LabWindows/CVI (a real IDE), authored a test runner and assertion library for D, and has worked on low-latency, high-throughput systems. However, the role hinges on deep Java/Kotlin/JVM and Spring ecosystem expertise, and the resume shows only incidental Java use (robotic arms, device orchestration ~2016-2018), no Kotlin, and no Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, Gradle/Maven, or application server work. Recent years are firmly TypeScript/Node/AWS. He could plausibly ramp up given his tooling instincts and language-implementation interests, but he would not be a strong match against candidates with direct JVM enterprise tooling backgrounds.
strengths: Prior hands-on IDE development (NI LabWindows/CVI) plus authored dev tooling (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts)
Broad systems depth: low-latency async services, embedded, desktop, and large open-source platform ownership
Strong engineering craft — TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, and demonstrated teaching/communication via talks and workshops
concerns: No demonstrated Spring, Quarkus, or Hibernate experience — a core required qualification
Java exposure is limited and dated; Kotlin is absent entirely from the resume
Recent 5+ years are TypeScript/Node/AWS-focused, indicating significant JVM ramp-up time
